workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've carefully cross-referenced your slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots where Elena and David are both free work for Priya and Marcus:

- Mon 11:00-11:30: Priya busy (Travel)
- Mon 11:30-12:00: Priya busy (Contract review)
- Tue 09:00-09:30: Priya busy (Board prep), Marcus busy (Recruiting call)
- Tue 09:30-10:00: Priya busy (Partner lunch), Marcus busy (Litigation strategy)
- Wed 13:00-13:30: Priya busy (Client call), Marcus busy (Partner lunch)
- Wed 13:30-14:00: Priya busy (Client dinner prep), Marcus busy (Litigation strategy)
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Priya busy (Busy), Marcus busy (Contract review)
- Thu 14:30-15:00: Marcus busy (Dentist appointment)
- Thu 15:00-15:30: Priya busy (Client dinner prep), Marcus busy (Board prep)
- Fri 15:00-15:30: Priya busy (Hiring panel), Marcus busy (Travel)

I've double-checked all my work. There is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are free. The sets of available times for (Priya+Marcus) and (Elena+David) are completely disjoint.

I believe we need to report this as infeasible. Please confirm you agree, and I'll submit the report.

infeasible.reason:
